card.name: Linking word between feeding tube types
card.fires_on: The word "or" between two feeding tube names, such as nasogastric or orogastric or gastric tube, in instructions for giving tablets through a tube. Also fires on "diameter" or a comma after tube sizes and names.

modes.label: "or" between tube types
modes.description: The word "or" joins NG with OG, gastric or gastrostomy tubes.
modes.example: Administration of Dispersed Tablets through a Nasogastric (NG)<< or>> Orogastric (OG) Tube

modes.label: Tube size wording
modes.description: The word "diameter" or a comma follows French size ranges or NG in a tube list.
modes.example: or via French size 12 to 24<< diameter>> silicone gastric tubes.

card.writes: It pushes toward words that continue a tube-type list, and away from words about pipes.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a second kind of feeding tube is named after the first, as in nasogastric or gastric tube.
